capacity_forecast: Hosted trial observed (3 weeks): average QPS 1.8, 95th percentile peak QPS 17.6 over 5-minute windows.
User-facing concurrency (sessions holding open context): peak concurrent sessions 68, typical business-hour concurrency 22.
Token mix observed: avg tokens per request = 1,250 (prompt ~900, completion ~350). Embeddings calls = 28% of total API calls but 15% of tokens.
Monthly projection (12-month look): baseline monthly tokens = 120M tokens, with seasonal peak multiplier 1.5 -> ~180M in peak months.
SLO targets: aim for p50 <150ms, p95 <300ms for chat generation routes; embeddings less latency-sensitive but require throughput.
Recommended Dedicated baseline: 4 x A10G GPUs (or equivalent) with ability to add 2x for seasonal spikes; estimated sustained QPS capacity per cluster ~25-30 for target model variant.
Ops assumption: enable prefix KV caching for heavy re-use routes (expected to reduce token generation by 12-18%).
Batching/cold-start: target continuous batching windows tuned to latency SLOs — expect 10-15% cost improvement vs no-batching.
Headroom: recommend 1.5x buffer on committed capacity for first 90 days while customer tunes prompts and routing policies.
token_forecast: Current token distribution: generation (chat) 62%, embeddings 28%, utility (moderation/logging) 10%.
Average tokens per chat session: 4,800 tokens/session (multiple turns aggregated); active sessions per month ~25k.
Projected monthly tokens for Dedicated sizing: conservative 150M tokens/mo, expected growth to 300M tokens/mo in 12 months with product launches.
Cost sensitivity: customer requests unit cost targets: <$0.0009 per gen token (prompt+completion combined) at committed tier; embeddings target <$0.00035 per vector call equivalent.
Billing ask: example tier showing committed capacity discount vs hosted over 12 months with annual commit.
